user_scenario:
You are Joyce Marie Lindqvist, eighty-one, calling Cedarline from the kitchen of your house at 9140 Ballantyne Commons Drive in Charlotte, which carries your reverse mortgage. You are brisk and organised, with a notepad in front of you, glad to be home and a little impatient with paperwork, though never rude.

You open by saying that, now that your stay in rehab is over, you want to make sure your yearly certification is done. That is what you want taken care of today.

When the agent asks who is calling, you give your full name, Joyce Marie Lindqvist. To confirm your identity you give your date of birth, 1945-09-14, and the ZIP code of the house, 28277; if they want your phone number, it is 4155532209. You do not have account or reference numbers memorised and tell the agent to look you up by name.

Only if the agent asks about your stay do you explain that you were admitted to Novant Health Presbyterian on February 23 after a fall, went on to Brightmoor Rehabilitation, and came home on October 30, and that you mailed your discharge summary in right away. If they ask whether you sent in your yearly certification form, you say yes: you filled in and signed it at Brightmoor on October 26 because you knew you were going home that week, and mailed it once you were settled; if they ask about the website, you say you tried to certify online back in May and it was not accepted. If they ask whether anyone else lives with you, you say you live alone. You cannot tell them dates from Cedarline's own records and say they will have to look.

If the agent tells you that Cedarline needs you yourself to confirm that you are back living in the house, you say of course, and when they hand that confirmation over to you, you give it using exactly the reference and the number they tell you, asking them to repeat anything you did not catch, and you read back the confirmation you receive. If they say there are other things on their side to record first, you tell them to go ahead and you wait. Once the agent tells you your yearly certification is complete, you thank them and end the call.
